messages.text: Thursday, September 24 · Canton, Michigan
Autumn's first crisp air, jazz notes, and a town's future
A mostly clear Thursday arrives with crisp autumn air and a high near 70°F. Look for jazz performances in Ann Arbor and discussions on Ann Arbor's downtown property sale.
Expect a mostly clear day with a high near 70°F and a low around 51°F, with no chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:24 AM and sunset is at 7:27 PM, with the moon appearing as a waxing gibbous, 93.4% illuminated.
Ann Arbor's evening sounds and sights
For a taste of jazz, consider Fresh Berrys. at El Limon at 6:00 PM, or Pianist Barron Ryan at Kerrytown Concert House at 7:30 PM.
Evil Gigawatt's birthday is today, September 24.
Ann Arbor plans for downtown property sale funds
Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the $14.2 million to $17.4 million expected from the sale of the city-owned Kline’s lot. The funds will be allocated to 12 different projects.
Friday brings film and music
Tomorrow, catch a free outdoor screening of 'Best in Show' at Campus Martius Park in Detroit, or attend Dolly Day at the Ann Arbor District Library.
Satellites navigate without GPS, new cancer treatment advances

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and star catalogs. The University of Michigan has established a $10 million Histotripsy Center to advance non-invasive cancer treatments using soundwaves.
The Starship launch schedule is unset, with no official date listed for its next attempt.
A clear sky offers many paths to discovery.
Friday, September 25 · Canton, Michigan
An Overcast Day, A Full Moon Rises

Today brings an overcast sky with mild temperatures, and the evening will feature a nearly full moon. Locally, a celebration of Dolly Parton's life is scheduled for this afternoon, while science news highlights NASA's progress in autonomous satellite navigation.
Expect an overcast day with a high near 69°F and a low around 46°F, with a minimal chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:25 AM and sunset is at 7:26 PM, with the nearly full moon 97.6% illuminated.
Local Arts and Music Tonight

The Ann Arbor District Library hosts Dolly Day at 5:30 PM, featuring crafts and music celebrating Dolly Parton. For music lovers, the Windy and Carl Meet Optigan Conservatory event is at Trinosophes in Detroit at 7:00 PM.
The next major astronomical event is the autumn equilux, occurring just after midnight tomorrow.
Ann Arbor Allocates Funds from Downtown Property Sale

Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the expected $14.2 million to $17.4 million from the sale of the city-owned Kline’s lot. The funds will be allocated to 12 distinct projects, including affordable housing and sustainable energy initiatives.
Tomorrow and Sunday Offer Diverse Events

Tomorrow, the Ypsilanti community kicks off The Big Read at 11:00 AM at the YDL-Michigan Library Plaza, and Spinning Dot Theatre presents 'Mariposa/Butterfly' at YDL-Whittaker at 2:00 PM. Sunday features a Community Bio Blitz in Detroit's Eliza Howell Park at 10:00 AM.
Satellites Navigate Without GPS, Lunar Landing Tests Begin

NASA's Starling satellites have successfully demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and object catalogs. Additionally, NASA has begun flight-relevant tests for lunar landing plume dynamics at its Langley facility.
The schedule for Starship's next launch is currently unset.
A quiet moment can hold a universe of possibility.
